About Us

The Story of Nooré Articles

نورے آرٹیکلز — روشنی اور خوبصورتی کا امتزاج

Nooré Articles was created with one simple dream — to bring the light (Noor) of Islamic art and heritage into every Muslim home. We offer Islamic wall art, calligraphy frames, wall clocks and illusion lamps that bring a spiritual touch to your home.

Every piece is chosen for its meaning and beauty, so that what you bring home is not just décor, but a source of peace and remembrance.

  • Islamic décor for homes and gifting
  • Cash on Delivery across Pakistan
  • Delivery in 3–5 working days
